newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia to issue next Eurobond in autumn.
newsitem.headline: Russia to issue next Eurobond in autumn.

text.p: Russia will make its next Eurobond issue at the latest in the autumn, or maybe earlier, if market conditions are favourable, Deputy Finance Minister Mikhail Kasyanov said on Friday.
"The next Eurobond is sure to be issued in autumn," Kasyanov told Reuters. "Market conditions will show whether we can make make it earlier."

A lot would depend on the results of the U.S. Federal Open Market Committee sitting scheduled for March 25. The committee plans to deliberate interest rates. Kasaynov confirmed the total volume of the issues would be about $2 billion.
Russia issued its first oversubscribed $1 billion Eurobond in November and a two billion mark Eurobond followed in March.
Russian officials said one of the new issues will be denominated in dollars. Russia also plans to issue a rouble-denominated Eurobond next year.
